title: eludite.editor.find_references input
description: Find All References (Shift+F12): ask the language server for every reference to the symbol at `line`, `column` (or the caret), including its declaration, and show them in the Find All References tool window, docked at the bottom beside the Error List and grouped by project, then file. A new search replaces the previous results and cancels a search still running; a result for an older document version or solution generation is dropped.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line of the symbol; the caret when omitted.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) of the symbol; 1 when omitted.
